ddl.where: addressed and answered_by_generation_id is null and skip_reason is null
ddl.name: ai_message_context_queue_idx

ddl.where: purged_at is null and status in ('pending','rejected','deleted')
ddl.name: attachments_sweep_idx

ddl.where: kind = 'channel' and slug is not null
ddl.name: conversations_org_slug_uq

ddl.value:
("kind" in ('chat','title') and "generation_id" is not null and "conversation_id" is not null)
        or ("kind" in ('digest','session_summary') and "subject_id" is not null and "generation_id" is null)
ddl.name: ai_usage_records_kind_check

ddl.value: char_length("schedule_cron") between 9 and 120 and char_length("time_zone") between 1 and 64
ddl.name: automation_drafts_schedule_len_check

ddl.value:
("target_kind" = 'dm' and "conversation_id" is null and "thread_root_message_id" is null)
        or ("target_kind" = 'channel' and "conversation_id" is not null and "thread_root_message_id" is null)
        or ("target_kind" = 'thread' and "conversation_id" is not null and "thread_root_message_id" is not null)
ddl.name: automation_drafts_target_check

ddl.value:
("source" = 'webhook' and "webhook_endpoint_id" is not null and "mailbox_id" is null)
        or ("source" = 'mail' and "mailbox_id" is not null and "webhook_endpoint_id" is null)
ddl.name: automation_events_source_check

ddl.value:
"content_purged_at" is null or ("subject" is null and "sender" is null and "body_text" is null
        and "body_json" is null and "thread_key" is null)
ddl.name: automation_events_purged_check

ddl.value:
("trigger_kind" = 'schedule' and "schedule_cron" is not null and "time_zone" is not null
          and char_length("schedule_cron") between 9 and 120 and char_length("time_zone") between 1 and 64)
        or ("trigger_kind" <> 'schedule' and "schedule_cron" is null and "time_zone" is null)
ddl.name: automations_schedule_check

ddl.value:
("target_kind" = 'dm' and "conversation_id" is null and "thread_root_message_id" is null
          and "board_column_id" is null)
        or ("target_kind" = 'channel' and "conversation_id" is not null and "thread_root_message_id" is null
          and "board_column_id" is null)
        or ("target_kind" = 'thread' and "conversation_id" is not null and "thread_root_message_id" is not null
          and "board_column_id" is null)
        or ("target_kind" = 'board' and "conversation_id" is not null and "board_column_id" is not null
          and "thread_root_message_id" is null)
ddl.name: automations_target_check

ddl.value:
("inbound_action" is not null) = ("trigger_kind" in ('webhook','mail'))
        and ("inbound_action" is null or "inbound_action" in ('post','board_card'))
        and ("inbound_action" is distinct from 'board_card' or "target_kind" = 'board')
ddl.name: automations_inbound_check

ddl.value:
"host" = lower("host") and char_length("host") between 1 and 260
      and position('/' in "host") = 0 and position('@' in "host") = 0
ddl.name: browser_contexts_host_check

ddl.value:
"opened_host" = lower("opened_host") and char_length("opened_host") between 1 and 260
      and position('/' in "opened_host") = 0 and position('@' in "opened_host") = 0
ddl.name: browser_contexts_opened_host_check

ddl.value:
"site_key" = lower("site_key") and char_length("site_key") between 1 and 260
      and position('/' in "site_key") = 0 and position('@' in "site_key") = 0
ddl.name: browser_sessions_site_key_check

ddl.value:
"host" = lower("host") and char_length("host") between 1 and 260
      and position('/' in "host") = 0 and position('@' in "host") = 0
ddl.name: browser_signin_requests_host_check

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'personal' and "agent_id" is not null and "owner_user_id" is not null and "unit_id" is null)
        or ("kind" = 'agent' and "agent_id" is not null and "owner_user_id" is null and "unit_id" is null)
        or ("kind" = 'unit' and "unit_id" is not null and "agent_id" is null and "owner_user_id" is null)
        or ("kind" = 'org' and "agent_id" is null and "owner_user_id" is null and "unit_id" is null)
ddl.name: memory_scopes_shape_check

ddl.value: "status_label" is null or char_length("status_label") between 1 and 24
ddl.name: message_cards_status_label_len_check

ddl.value: "path_prefix" is null or ("permission" like 'memory.%' and "path_prefix" like '%/')
ddl.name: permission_rules_path_prefix_check

ddl.value:
cardinality("egress_allow_hosts") <= 64
        and array_position("egress_allow_hosts", null) is null
ddl.name: sandbox_policies_allow_hosts_check

ddl.value:
"max_sandboxes" between 0 and 100 and "max_browsers" between 0 and 50
        and "cpu_minutes_per_day" between 1 and 100000 and "disk_per_bot_mb" between 64 and 102400
        and "disk_total_mb" between 64 and 1048576
ddl.name: sandbox_policies_limits_check

ddl.value:
array_position("approver_user_ids", null) is null and case when "approver_kind" = 'users'
        then cardinality("approver_user_ids") between 1 and 20
        else cardinality("approver_user_ids") = 0 end
ddl.name: tool_approval_policies_approvers_check

ddl.value: "tool_call_id" is null or char_length("tool_call_id") between 1 and 200
ddl.name: tool_call_approvals_tool_call_id_len_check

ddl.value:
("scope" = 'personal' and "owner_user_id" is not null and "unit_id" is null)
        or ("scope" = 'unit' and "owner_user_id" is null)
ddl.name: vault_items_scope_owner_check

ddl.value:
char_length("read_tool") between 1 and 200
        and ("write_tool" is null or char_length("write_tool") between 1 and 200)
        and ("note_tool" is null or char_length("note_tool") between 1 and 200)
ddl.name: watched_records_tools_len_check
